subject: Implementation plan: SSO/SCIM, IP allowlist and service-account stabilization for LumiCorp
messages:
From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@lumicorp.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@lumicorp.com>
Date: 2027-05-02T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Kickoff: LumiCorp access stabilization for prod onboarding

Hi Sean,

Thanks for taking this on. We're aiming to finish SSO + SCIM and lock down IP allowlists and service accounts before our prod go-live (target: 2027-06-03). High level asks:
- SAML SSO via Okta; LumiCorp will provide metadata.
- SCIM to provision/deprovision users from our HR system.
- IP allowlist for Redwood endpoints; list attached is our current Egress IPs.
- Service accounts: we need least-privilege patterns for CI jobs and nightly batch inference.

Can you share a practical sequence and any blockers you typically see? Also cc'ing Jordan (security) to confirm audit/log needs.

Thanks,
Alex Rivera
Head of Platform Ops
LumiCorp

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@lumicorp.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@lumicorp.com>
Date: 2027-05-02T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: LumiCorp access stabilization for prod onboarding

Alex — appreciate the clear list. Proposed sequence (short, actionable):

1) Collect artifacts (Day 0–2):
   - Okta SAML metadata (IdP metadata XML)
   - SCIM base URL + bearer token scope for provisioning
   - Egress IP ranges (you mentioned attached)
   - List of CI workloads that need service accounts + brief privilege matrix

2) SSO smoke validation (Day 3–5):
   - Configure a test SP metadata in a staging LumiCorp Okta tenant
   - Validate assertion attributes (email, name, groups) and default role mapping
   - Deliver a short SSO test script (included in checklist)

3) SCIM pilot (Day 6–10):
   - Enable provisioning for a small group (10 users) -> validate create/update/deactivate events
   - Confirm group sync semantics and delta-sync cadence

4) IP allowlist window + NAT alignment (Day 6–12):
   - Confirm which Redwood endpoints need allowlisting (auth, inference, upload)
   - Schedule a maintenance window for cutover (15–30 min)

5) Service-account stabilization (Day 8–14):
   - Provide proposed least-privilege roles for batch and CI service accounts
   - Exchange signed policy for vault/KMS access patterns

6) Pre-prod rehearsal & audit check (Day 13–18):
   - Run end-to-end test: provisioning, SSO login, token refresh flow, inference call from service account
   - Produce audit log snippet and retention policy statement for your security team

Attachments: I attached a one-page checklist (LumiCorp_SSO_SCIM_Checklist.xlsx) — start there and we'll iterate.

If that timeline works, Monica will pick up SSO/SCIM config handoffs and Ben will own the service-account and IP allowlist coordination.

Next step: can you confirm which Okta environment (prod vs sandbox) we'll use for staging validation and share the metadata?

—Sean
Sean Gallagher
Customer Success, Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@lumicorp.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@lumicorp.com>
Date: 2027-05-03T08:24:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: LumiCorp access stabilization for prod onboarding

Alex — quick implementation notes from CS side:

- Okta attributes: we strongly prefer an immutable id (okta.user.id) in the NameID if you can provide it; email-only mappings lead to drift in our experience.
- SCIM tokens: give a scoped token limited to /Users and /Groups, and rotate once we complete pilot.
- Group-to-role mapping: send a short mapping table (group name -> Redwood role). We'll use this for provisioning RBAC.

Two small gotchas we've seen:
- If your HR system sends inactive users as active for a short delay, SCIM delta sync may re-provision. We'll add a guard in our staging policy to treat 'inactive' state with higher precedence.
- IP allowlist + CDN: if your infra terminates at a CDN with dynamic egress, share the NAT ranges rather than CDN frontends.

I captured those items in the checklist and prefixed them under "Implementation Notes".

Monica Patel
Implementation Lead, Redwood Inference

From: Procurement <procurement@lumicorp.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@lumicorp.com>
Date: 2027-05-04T15:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: LumiCorp access stabilization for prod onboarding

Hi Sean/Monica,

Quick procurement question to avoid delays to the schedule: for dedicated IP allowlist windows we need a signed change-control doc and an SLA addendum confirming maintenance windows won't exceed 30 minutes for production access changes. Can you attach a template SLA addendum or point to the standard doc? Also confirm billing contact for any emergency change logs.

Thanks,
Procurement Team
LumiCorp

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Procurement <procurement@lumicorp.com>, Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@lumicorp.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@lumicorp.com>
Date: 2027-05-06T16:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: LumiCorp access stabilization for prod onboarding

Thanks — looping in ops & legal templates. A couple of tech notes while we get docs in motion:

- Service accounts proposal: see attached svcacct-privileges-proposal.csv. TL;DR: two types
  1) short-lived CI token (20m TTL) scoped to inference:invoke + model:read
  2) batch job svcacct with restricted S3 read + limited inference:invoke for nightly runs

- IP allowlist plan: we'll provide a signed change-control template (I put the DocuSign link in related_links) and keep the maintenance window to 15 minutes for the cutover; rollback steps included.

- Audit/logging: Redwood retention default is 90 days for token-level traces; we can extend to 1 year as an add-on if LumiCorp needs it for compliance. Jordan — tagging you for retention policy confirmation.

I'll upload the signed templates to the shared doc and ping when DocuSign is ready.

—Ben Carter
Lead Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

> Attachment stubs: svcacct-privileges-proposal.csv (CSV, 18 rows)
